messages:
anne: Quick follow-up from the gateway RFC — thinking about adding a per-request "reliability budget" propagated as a header so edge can decide: retry, hedge, or short-circuit to cache/cheap variant.
sam: Can you outline the threat model? when would we consume budget?
anne: idea: budget is integer tokens in header `X-Reliability-Budget`. Edge decrements on each extra attempt or expensive shadow call. If budget==0 => no retries, immediate 429 or fallback.
jin: How to prevent clients from faking header? we only honor server-signed budget or edge-allocated budgets tied to API keys.
leo: streaming case: if a stream is midflight and we retry, could double-execute side-effects. Suggest we only retry pre-output or use rerouting to stateless model variants. Also consider KV prefix cache to avoid full exec.
anne: agreed — retry only before first non-reversible token. For streams we should surface `stream-retry-allowed: true|false` to the client via response header.
sam: ops concern: burst behaviour. propose token-bucket at frontdoor per-tenant with burst capacity bounded by committed Dedicated capacity. i.e.
```
tenant_buckets:
  default:
    capacity: 50
    refill: 10/s
``` 
jin: router should consult budget+bucket. If both allow, permit 1 hedge attempt to a cheaper variant. Hedge policy: probabilistic for low-latency critical paths.
leo: fallback actions in order: 1) prefix cache 2) cheap model variant 3) 429 w/ Retry-After 4) synchronous fallback to Dedicated pool. Need observability: emit `budget_used`, `hedge_attempt`, `fallback_taken` tags.
ops-bot: alert: gateway v2 can emit `X-Reliability-Budget-Allocated` in logs; 0.15% increase in 5xx when hedging experiments enabled last week.
sam: Question — what about cross-service correlation? need a trace header preserved across hedges and fallbacks: `x-rw-trace`.
anne: agreed. Also propose a small schema for signed budgets so we can allocate server-side: `budget=v1;ts=...;sig=...`
jin: Implementation note: keep cheap variant registry in the model-catalog, annotated with `fallback-grade` and cost estimate. Router picks best-fit.
leo: small UX: expose `X-Reliability-Used` to client so apps can surface degraded behaviour.
anne: ok next steps: write short RFC fragment for signature scheme + sample gateway config and add unit test for streaming no-double-exec. I'll draft in next 24h. :thumbsup:
sam: SGTM
jin: I'll spike on signed token format.
leo: I'll add metrics names to the observability checklist.
ops-bot: deployment: canary flag `gateway.reliability-budget=true` rolled to 10%.
